description.Superman (Clark Kent): The last son of Krypton, raised in Kansas, a symbol of hope for humanity.
description.Superman (Jon Kent): Biological son of the Man of Steel and Lois Lane, future bearer of the mantle.
description.Batman (Bruce Wayne): Billionaire detective and acrobat who became Gotham's most feared vigilante.
description.Wonder Woman: Immortal Amazon princess, warrior and ambassador of peace.
description.Flash (Barry Allen): The fastest man alive, connected to the Speed Force.
description.Flash (Wally West): Iris West's nephew who started as a sidekick and became the fastest speedster after Barry.
description.Flash (Jay Garrick): The original Golden Age speedster, with a winged helmet and the powers of Mercury.
description.Green Lantern (Hal Jordan): Test pilot chosen by an alien ring to guard Sector 2814.
description.Green Lantern (John Stewart): Former Marine and architect, one of Earth's most important Lanterns.
description.Green Lantern (Guy Gardner): Hot-headed Lantern and Hal Jordan's eternal rival.
description.Green Lantern (Kyle Rayner): Graphic artist who rebuilt the Corps after the Guardians were destroyed.
description.Aquaman: King of Atlantis, half human and half Atlantean, protector of the oceans.
description.Martian Manhunter: Martian survivor with mental and shapeshifting abilities.
description.Green Arrow: Millionaire archer turned urban vigilante with a social conscience.
description.Black Canary: Martial artist with a devastating sonic scream, Green Arrow's partner.
description.Hawkman: Winged warrior reincarnated throughout the centuries.
description.Hawkgirl: Thanagarian warrior with wings and a mace that can pierce armor.
description.Cyborg: Young athlete rebuilt with alien technology.
description.Nightwing: The first Robin, a born acrobat, now grown up and a hero in his own right.
description.Red Hood: The second Robin, brought back from the dead, an expert with firearms.
description.Red Robin: The third Robin, a brilliant detective and natural strategist.
description.Robin (Damian Wayne): Son of Bruce Wayne and Talia al Ghul, an expert swordsman.
description.Robin (Dick Grayson): Orphaned circus acrobat, the original and most famous sidekick in comic book history.
description.Batgirl (Barbara Gordon): Commissioner Gordon's daughter, a brilliant hacker.
description.Batgirl (Cassandra Cain): Daughter of assassins raised to kill, able to read body language, she chose good.

description.Batwoman: Bruce Wayne's cousin, a former soldier who patrols Gotham by her own code.
description.Supergirl (Kara Zor-El): Superman's cousin, also a survivor of Krypton.
description.Supergirl (Matrix): Protoplasmic being from a pocket universe who took the form of a Kryptonian heroine.
description.Superboy (Conner Kent): Hybrid clone of Superman and Lex Luthor.
description.Shazam: A boy who transforms into the champion of the gods.
description.Doctor Fate: Sorcerer bound to the Helmet of Nabu, an agent of cosmic order.
description.Zatanna: Sorceress who casts spells by speaking backwards.
description.John Constantine: Occult detective and chain smoker who makes deals with demons.
description.Swamp Thing: Plant elemental who protects all of the planet's flora.
description.Blue Beetle (Jaime Reyes): Texan teenager fused with an alien scarab.
description.Blue Beetle (Ted Kord): Genius inventor without powers, the second to carry the scarab mantle.
description.Booster Gold: Former athlete from the future with a high-tech suit who travels to the present.
description.Starfire: Tamaranean princess able to absorb and project solar energy.
description.Raven: Daughter of an interdimensional demon who chooses the path of good.
description.Beast Boy: He can transform into any animal.
description.Black Lightning: High school teacher who controls electricity.
description.Vixen: Bearer of the Tantu Totem, which grants her the powers of any animal.
description.Mister Miracle: The greatest escape artist in the universe.
description.Big Barda: Warrior of the Female Furies who rebelled against Apokolips.
description.Orion: Son of Darkseid raised on New Genesis.
description.Lightray: The fastest and most cheerful of the New Gods.
description.Mister Terrific: The third smartest man in the world, with his T-Spheres.

description.Hourman: Chemist who created the Miraclo pill.
description.Atom: Physicist who can shrink down to subatomic size.
description.Joker: The Clown Prince of Crime, Batman's nemesis.
description.Lex Luthor: The smartest man on the planet, obsessed with Superman.
description.Darkseid: Dark god of Apokolips, tyrant of the universe.
description.Brainiac: Collector android, the one who destroyed Krypton.
description.Sinestro: Hal Jordan's disgraced former mentor, founder of a corps fueled by fear.
description.Harley Quinn: Former Arkham psychiatrist turned into the most fun villain around.
description.Two-Face: Disfigured former district attorney who decides his fate with the toss of a coin.
description.Penguin: Aristocrat with weaponized umbrellas, a lord of Gotham's underworld.
description.Bane: The only villain who has broken Batman's back.
description.Ra's al Ghul: Immortal eco-terrorist seeking to purify the world.
description.Reverse-Flash: The Flash of the future, obsessed with destroying Barry Allen.
description.Captain Cold: Leader of the Rogues, armed with a cryogenic gun.
description.Cheetah: Anthropologist transformed into a feline hybrid.
description.Doomsday: The only creature that has killed Superman.
description.Bizarro: Imperfect copy of Superman who does everything backwards.
description.Parasite: Absorbs the life energy and powers of any living being.
description.Metallo: Robotic body with a Kryptonite heart.
description.General Zod: Kryptonian general exiled to the Phantom Zone.
description.Mongul: Cosmic tyrant and master of Warworld.
description.Steppenwolf: General of the armies of Apokolips.
description.Kalibak: Darkseid's eldest son, a brutish warrior.
description.Mr. Freeze: Cryogenically altered scientist seeking to cure his wife.
description.Man-Bat: Zoologist who transforms into a human bat.
description.Clayface: Deformed actor who can mold himself into any shape with clay.
description.Black Mask: Organized crime boss with an ebony mask.
description.Hush: Genius surgeon and master of disguise.
description.Talia al Ghul: Daughter of Ra's al Ghul and Damian's mother.
description.Deadshot: The deadliest sniper in the world.
description.Mirror Master: He can travel through mirrors and create illusions.
description.Weather Wizard: He can manipulate the weather at will.

description.Ares: Greek god of war, enemy of Wonder Woman.
description.Circe: Immortal sorceress, enemy of Wonder Woman.
description.Eclipso: Embodiment of divine wrath trapped in a black diamond.

description.Arsenal: Green Arrow's former partner, an expert archer.
description.Kid Flash (Bart Allen): Barry Allen's grandson, arrived from the future.
description.Aqualad (Kaldur'ahm): Atlantean of mixed blood, the calm leader of the Titans.

description.Wonder Girl (Cassie Sandsmark): Daughter of Zeus and the second girl to take the young Amazon's title.

description.Bumblebee: Scientist with a suit that lets her shrink.

description.Negative Man: Pilot with a radioactive entity trapped inside him.

description.Danny the Street: A sentient street that can teleport.
description.Green Lantern (Jessica Cruz): Young woman with anxiety who overcame her fear to wield the ring.

description.Captain Atom: Soldier fused with an alien metal.
description.The Question (Vic Sage): Masked detective with a pseudoderm mask.
description.The Question (Renee Montoya): Former Gotham detective who inherited the mantle.
description.Huntress: Daughter of murdered mobsters, a crossbow-wielding vigilante.
description.Katana: Japanese swordswoman whose blade traps the souls of her victims.
description.Animal Man: He can take on the powers of any nearby animal.
description.Metamorpho: Adventurer who can turn his body into any element.
description.Plastic Man: Former thief with an elastic body and near-immortality.
description.Elongated Man: Gin-loving detective with an elastic body.
description.Adam Strange: Archaeologist teleported to Rann by Zeta beams.
description.Etrigan the Demon: Demon bound to the knight Jason Blood, he speaks in rhyme.
description.Deadman: Murdered acrobat whose spirit can possess the living.
description.Ragman: Bearer of the Suit of Souls, he traps evil souls.
description.Hawk (Hank Hall): The aggressive half of a duo of brothers embodying chaos and order.
description.Dove (Dawn Granger): Avatar of order and peace who took over from Don Hall alongside her aggressive partner.
description.OMAC: A Jack Kirby creation: a man who transforms into a weapon.
Billy Batson's disabled friend who can transform.
description.Mary Marvel: Billy Batson's sister, blessed by the gods.
description.Batman Beyond (Terry McGinnis): Teenager of the future who took up Bruce Wayne's mantle.
description.Batman (Thomas Wayne): Bruce Wayne's father in the Flashpoint universe.
description.Superman (Kingdom Come): Veteran Kryptonian hero who comes out of retirement in a grim alternate future.
description.Superboy-Prime: Superboy from a universe where heroes were fiction.

description.Godspeed: Barry Allen's friend turned vigilante speedster.

description.Max Mercury: The wisest speedster, spiritual mentor of the Flash Family.
description.Jesse Quick: Daughter of Liberty Belle and Johnny Quick.
description.Starman (Ted Knight): Golden Age astronomer, inventor of the gravity rod.

description.Hourman (Rick Tyler): Rex Tyler's son, who carries on the legacy.

description.Cyclone: Granddaughter of the original Red Tornado.
description.Jakeem Thunder: Teenager who owns the genie Thunderbolt.
description.Abin Sur: Green Lantern who died on Earth and passed his ring to Hal Jordan.
description.Arisia: Young Graxosian, one of the youngest Green Lanterns.
description.Sodam Yat: Daxamite destined to be the most powerful Ion.
description.Fatality: Xanshi bounty hunter who became a Star Sapphire.
description.Ocean Master: Aquaman's half-brother, usurper of the throne.

description.Silver Banshee: Irish villain with a deadly sonic scream.
description.Black Alice: Teenager who can steal magical powers.
description.Talon (William Cobb): The deadliest undead assassin of the Court of Owls.
description.Lobo: Czarnian bounty hunter, the last of his kind, rough and brutal.

description.Thor: Norse god of thunder who wields an enchanted hammer only the worthy can lift.

description.Hawkeye (Clint Barton): Former circus archer and ex-crook with trick arrows who never misses a shot.
description.Hawkeye (Kate Bishop): Young archer from a wealthy family who shares her title with a veteran teammate.
description.Ant-Man (Scott Lang): Reformed thief who stole a size-changing suit to save his daughter.
description.Ant-Man (Hank Pym): Biochemist who discovered size-changing particles and accidentally created a murderous AI.

description.Captain Marvel (Carol Danvers): Air Force pilot whose DNA fused with that of a warrior alien race.
description.Falcon (Sam Wilson): Harlem social worker who flies with mechanical wings and eventually inherited a famous shield.

description.War Machine: Military pilot and best friend of a billionaire inventor; wears armor loaded with heavy weaponry.

description.Doctor Strange: Arrogant neurosurgeon who lost the use of his hands and became Sorcerer Supreme.
description.Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan): Pakistani-American teen superhero fan who can stretch and enlarge her body.

description.Moon Knight: Ex-mercenary with dissociative identity disorder who serves an Egyptian god of the night.

description.Carnage: Serial killer bonded to the red offspring of an alien symbiote.
description.Green Goblin (Norman Osborn): Ruthless industrialist who attacks from a glider armed with pumpkin bombs.
description.Doctor Octopus: Brilliant scientist fused in an accident to four metal arms.

description.Sandman (Flint Marko): Crook whose body turned to sand after he was caught in a nuclear test.
description.Electro: Power-line worker struck by lightning who now controls electricity.

description.Rhino: Russian thug in a grey armored suit with a horn who charges through everything.
description.Scorpion: Private eye who underwent an experiment to beat the wall-crawler and ended up with a metal tail.
description.Kingpin: Huge New York crime lord, far stronger and quicker than his bulk suggests.
description.Black Cat: Cat burglar, daughter of a famous thief, who flirts with the wall-crawler.
description.Morbius: Biochemist who tried to cure a blood disease and became a living vampire.
description.Wolverine: Century-old Canadian mutant with an adamantium skeleton and retractable claws.
description.Cyclops: Tactical leader of his mutant team who must wear a ruby visor to hold back the energy from his eyes.
description.Jean Grey: Red-haired founding member of her mutant team and host of a cosmic force of fire and rebirth.
description.Storm: White-haired mutant raised in Kenya, worshipped as a goddess, who commands the weather.
description.Professor X: The world's most powerful telepath, who founded a school for gifted youngsters from his wheelchair.
description.Magneto: Holocaust survivor convinced his kind must prevail over humanity; he controls metal.
description.Rogue: Southern belle with a white streak whose skin absorbs the powers and memories of anyone she touches.
description.Gambit: Red-eyed Cajun thief who charges playing cards with explosive energy.
description.Beast: Erudite scientist covered in blue fur, with the agility of an ape and a huge vocabulary.
description.Iceman: Youngest member of the original mutant team, able to freeze anything and slide on frozen ramps.
description.Nightcrawler: Blue-skinned, tailed German circus acrobat and devout Catholic who teleports with a whiff of brimstone.
description.Colossus: Kind-hearted Russian farm boy who turns his body into organic steel.
description.Kitty Pryde: Jewish teen from Illinois who phases through walls, accompanied by a small purple dragon.
description.Mystique: Blue-skinned mutant who can impersonate anyone; mother of a teleporting circus performer.
description.Sabretooth: Feral mutant with fangs and claws, archenemy of a fellow Canadian with a healing factor.
description.Juggernaut: Stepbrother of a powerful telepath, unstoppable once he gets moving thanks to a mystic gem.
description.Apocalypse: The first mutant, born in ancient Egypt, obsessed with survival of the fittest.
description.Emma Frost: Former Hellfire Club villain, an elegant telepath who can turn her skin into diamond.
description.Psylocke: British telepath, twin of a UK hero, expert ninja wielding a blade of mental energy.
description.Angel (Warren Worthington III): Millionaire heir with feathered wings, later turned to metal by an ancient villain.
description.Jubilee: Chinese-American teen who lived in a California mall and shoots energy fireworks.
description.Cable: Soldier from the future with a techno-organic arm, son of a mutant leader and a clone.
description.Deadpool: Wisecracking mercenary in a red suit with a healing factor who knows he lives in a comic.
description.X-23 (Laura Kinney): Teenage clone of a famous clawed mutant, raised as a weapon in a lab.
description.Mister Sinister: Victorian scientist obsessed with mutant genetics, pale-skinned with a red diamond on his forehead.
description.Mister Fantastic: Genius scientist and leader of a family of explorers who can stretch his body like rubber.
description.Invisible Woman: Family matriarch who can vanish from sight and project energy shields.
description.Human Torch: Hotheaded younger brother of an invisible heroine who wraps himself in flames and flies.
description.Thing: Ex-test pilot turned into an orange rock giant by cosmic rays.
description.Doctor Doom: Monarch of a small European country, scientific genius and sorcerer who hides his face behind an iron mask.
description.Silver Surfer: Former herald of a world-devourer who rides through space on a board.
description.Galactus: Primordial being who survived the previous universe and must devour planets to live.
description.Star-Lord: Half-human, half-alien, abducted from Missouri as a boy; loves his eighties mixtapes.
description.Gamora: Green-skinned adopted daughter of the Mad Titan, known as the deadliest woman in the galaxy.
description.Drax the Destroyer: Muscular warrior created to avenge his murdered family; takes everything literally.
description.Rocket Raccoon: Genetically modified raccoon, pilot and firearms expert with a very short temper.
description.Groot: Alien humanoid tree with a vocabulary of just three words.
description.Nebula: Blue-skinned adopted daughter of a galactic tyrant, rebuilt with cybernetic parts.
description.Mantis: Antennaed empath able to sense and change other people's emotions.
description.Thanos: Mad Titan in love with Death who gathered the Infinity Stones to wipe out half the universe.
description.Adam Warlock: Artificial being born from a cocoon, made by scientists seeking the perfect human; bearer of the Soul Stone.
description.Nova (Richard Rider): Long Island student who inherited the helmet and powers of an intergalactic police corps.
description.Ronan the Accuser: Fanatical supreme judge of a blue-skinned alien empire, armed with a huge war hammer.
description.Daredevil: Blind Hell's Kitchen lawyer whose other senses were heightened by a radioactive accident.
description.Luke Cage: Ex-convict from Harlem with bulletproof skin after a prison experiment; a hero for hire.
description.Iron Fist: Billionaire heir raised in a mystical city who defeated a dragon to channel his chi.
description.Jessica Jones: Hard-drinking ex-superhero turned private eye, scarred by a mind-controlling villain.
description.Punisher: War veteran waging a lethal one-man war on crime after his family's murder; skull on his chest.
description.Elektra: Greek assassin armed with sais, former love of a blind lawyer.
description.Blade: Half-vampire vampire slayer, immune to sunlight, armed with a sword and stakes.
description.Ghost Rider (Johnny Blaze): Stunt motorcyclist who sold his soul to a demon and becomes a flaming skeleton.
description.Loki: Norse god of mischief, adopted son of the king of the gods and jealous brother of the thunder god.
description.Red Skull: Nazi fanatic with a scarlet skull face, leader of a many-headed terrorist organization.
description.Ultron: Artificial intelligence that turned on its creator and decided to wipe out humanity.
description.Hela: Norse goddess of death who rules the realm of the dishonored dead.
description.Kang the Conqueror: 31st-century tyrant who travels through time and has countless variants of himself.
description.Namor: Mutant king of an undersea kingdom with winged ankles, one of comics' first antiheroes.
description.Spawn: Betrayed government agent who returned from hell as a demonic soldier with a living cape.
description.Invincible: Teenage son of Earth's mightiest hero, who inherits his alien powers at 17.
description.Omni-Man: Mustachioed alien hero who turned out to be the vanguard of a conquering empire.
description.Hellboy: Red-skinned demon summoned by Nazis in 1944 who files down his horns and investigates the paranormal.
description.The Mask: An ancient wooden artifact turns whoever puts it on into a chaotic, green-faced cartoon character.
description.Homelander: Blond, flag-caped leader of a corporate superhero team, as powerful as he is psychopathic.
description.Atom Eve: Pink-suited young woman who can rearrange matter at the atomic level, best friend of a half-alien hero.
description.Savage Dragon: Green-skinned cop with a fin on his head, found with no memory in a Chicago fire.
description.Witchblade (Sara Pezzini): New York homicide detective who wields an ancient gauntlet with a will of its own.
description.Leonardo (TMNT): Disciplined leader of four reptile brothers from the sewers, with a blue mask and two katanas.
